paragraphs.text: Native Astra inspected the project, implemented the verifier and CLI, and corrected an import-test fixture. It finished in eight model requests and passed all five original acceptance groups.

Six additional checks were run after the recording. Five passed; a root containing an ancestor symlink followed by .. selected the lexical directory instead of the directory reached by the filesystem. Open Tests for the exact probe and result.

explanation.title: One batch. Less context. A finished tool.

paragraphs.text: Astra inspected the starter and tests together, then applied the three-part API and CLI patch once. It retained executable checks and exercised the CLI before finishing. The run used seven model requests and passed all five original acceptance groups.

Compared with this fresh native Astra run, the factory used 41% less input, 10% less output and 3% less wall time. Native had more prefix-cache hits. Both finished programs missed the same root-identity case in the six additional post-run checks; all results are in Tests.

Astra reviewed Terra’s code and caught a root-identity defect: resolving link/.. as text can choose a different directory from the one the filesystem reaches. Terra repaired the path handling and retained a regression assertion, with Astra steering the distinction between JavaScript and native filesystem resolution.

All five original acceptance groups passed. In six identical additional checks, this was the only finished program to pass all six; the other three missed root identity. Both supervisor and worker usage are counted. This deeper review took substantially more time and tokens than either solo run.

Astra suspected that the digest regex accepted a trailing newline and commissioned a repair. Sol’s runtime probe disproved that diagnosis. Astra acknowledged the evidence, corrected its instruction, and asked Sol to finish with explicit validation and retained tests.

The integrated project passed all five original acceptance groups. It passed five of the six additional post-run checks and missed root identity. The recording also exposed a handoff bug that froze an earlier worker’s generated tests; that factory issue was fixed in the following revision.
